newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-SRI LANKA'S DE SILVA SCORES NINTH TEST HUNDRED.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKA'S DE SILVA SCORES NINTH TEST HUNDRED.

text.p: Sri Lankan vice-captain Aravinda de Silva stroked his ninth test hundred to carry his side to a 234-run lead with two sessions remaining in the first test against Pakistan on Wednesday.
Sri Lanka, trailing by 48 runs on the first innings, went to lunch on the fifth day at 282 for four with de Silva progressing to 115 not out in a stay of 382 minutes. He hit one six and eight fours.
De Silva, resuming at his overnight total of 79, moved to his century in singles although both Saqlain Mushtaq and Mushtaq Ahmed tempted him with full tosses.
De Silva completed his hundred with a single off his legs in 235 balls with one six and seven fours.
His last hundred was also against Pakistan -- 105 at Faisalabad in 1995-96.
De Silva and Hashan Tillekeratne added 83 for the fourth wicket before Tillekeratne fell to Saqlain.
His wicket was the only one to fall in the morning session. The left-hander, on reaching his half century, failed to get to the pitch of the ball from Saqlain and holed out to Rameez Raja at mid-off.
Tillekeratne scored 54 off 95 balls with five fours.
Romesh Kaluwitharana, who replaced him at the wicket, was undefeated on six at the break.
